note: Trailer (title screen demo). Subtitles on black or dark frames are replaced. Text that can't be erased cleanly stays and gets an English line with a black outline: overlays on the picture, the hero's line over his face (258-303), gameplay captions and the kanji titles from MOV05. Letterboxed part (660-860): picture rows 64-175, logo at the bottom right, so English goes in the top band.

subtitles.text: In the midst of an endless adventure,
you will meet and part again and again,
as irreplaceable companions...
...or as enemies standing in your way.

All I wanted was power.
That was all...
A giant tower reaching to the heavens
SPECTRAL TOWER
A grand adventure of 10,000 floors
Random maps! Unravel the great labyrinth!
Awaken, Roots! O memories of blood!
Inherit 100 skills and aim for the top floor!
Those who consume...
...and those who create.
Which of them will be chosen?
Infinite power, eternal life,
forbidden desires, wounding nature,
wounding the earth... after the slaughter,
what is gained is the power of desire.
That is sin. Human sin.
Coming here made it clear to me.
I was called by this tower...
I'll tell you this much...
